== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* Known in Brazil for his participations in the [[CBLOL]] playing for [[Vivo Keyd Stars]], once in 2019 and another in 2023.
* He likes the Brazilian style of play, which he considers to be an "aggressive but risky game." <ref name="interview with grell prensa esports 2024">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VMYVyy8Qd4c Prensa Esports video post] ''youtube.com''</ref>
* Has a son, who was born in 2025.<ref>[https://x.com/GrellLol/status/1878135224208351597 Grell's X Post] ''x.com''</ref>
